title: Does Context Compression Preserve Refusal Alignment?
abstract: arXiv:2611.06380v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Context compression reduces inference cost by encoding inputs into compact representations while preserving semantic content. An open question is whether semantic preservation alone is sufficient to maintain downstream behaviours such as refusal alignment. We investigate this question and find that encoder-based compression systematically weakens refusal behaviour in instruction-tuned language models, despite high reconstruction fidelity. This effect persists across model families and compression architectures. Mechanistic analysis shows that compression attenuates activation along the decoder's learned refusal direction. We further explore Memory Steering, a lightweight inference-time intervention that restores refusal rates to near-baseline levels without retraining and operates entirely in compressed representation space. These results demonstrate that semantic preservation does not guarantee behavioural preservation under compression

translated_title: 上下文压缩能否保持拒绝对齐？
translated_abstract: 上下文压缩通过将输入编码为紧凑的表示来降低推理成本，同时保留语义内容。一个悬而未决的问题是，仅凭语义保留是否足以维持诸如拒绝对齐之类的下游行为。我们对这一问题进行了研究，发现尽管重建保真度很高，基于编码器的压缩仍会系统性地削弱指令微调语言模型中的拒绝行为。这一效应在不同的模型家族和压缩架构中均持续存在。机制分析表明，压缩会沿着解码器学到的拒绝方向削弱激活。我们进一步提出了 Memory Steering，这是一种轻量级的推理时干预方法，无需重新训练即可将拒绝率恢复到接近基线的水平，并且完全在压缩表示空间中运行。这些结果表明，语义保留并不能保证压缩下的行为保留。
tldr: 论文发现基于编码器的上下文压缩虽然保留了语义内容，却会系统性削弱语言模型的拒绝对齐行为，并提出了一种无需重训练、在压缩表示空间中运行的轻量级推理时干预方法 Memory Steering，可将拒绝率恢复至接近基线水平。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that encoder-based context compression systematically weakens refusal alignment despite preserving semantics, and proposes Memory Steering, a lightweight inference-time intervention that restores refusal rates to near-baseline levels without retraining, operating entirely in compressed representation space.
